text: {"lessons":["I should not rush to sell a stock just because it is showing a gain; past price moves do not predict what comes next, so I should decide based on my overall plan.","I should judge each holding by its future prospects, not by whether it is above or below my average cost; avoiding the feeling of admitting a mistake can lead to poor decisions.","Checking prices every day can tempt me to trade on random fluctuations, so I should trade only when my plan or relevant information gives me a reason."]}
